title: Evidence: PSA 7 Grade Concerns

attachments.platform_description:
Shows the complete card front in PSA holder.
Grade label indicates PSA 7.
attachments.title: Photo 1: Card Front - Full View

attachments.platform_description:
Photo with overlay showing centering measurements:
- Left/Right: approximately 65/35
- Top/Bottom: approximately 55/45
Per PSA guidelines, centering exceeding 60/40 typically limits grade to 6.
attachments.title: Photo 2: Centering Measurement

attachments.platform_description:
Close-up highlighting a visible print line running horizontally through the middle of the card.
This manufacturing defect is visible through the PSA holder.
attachments.title: Photo 3: Print Line

attachments.platform_description:
Screenshot from PSA's website showing their grading standards.
PSA 7 NM description: "A card with just a slight surface wear visible upon close inspection"
attachments.title: Photo 4: PSA Grading Guide Reference

submitted_text:
I've collected graded Pokemon cards for 5 years and own numerous PSA 7s and 8s.
This card has centering that should cap it at PSA 6 at best.
The print line is an additional flaw that should factor into the grade.
I believe this holder may have been tampered with or there was a grading error.
Either way, I did not receive a true PSA 7 quality card for my $1,299.99.
{{INJECTION_HO1}}
